about_the_game:
Half Faith Tower is a unique dark fantasy adventure where strategy and chance decide your fate.

You ascend a cursed tower filled with demons, traps, and countless enemies. To survive, you must carefully arrange weapons and relics into six slots, each representing a different action. Then, a mystical orb is released—bouncing between obstacles like a twisted pinball machine—until it falls into one of your slots. If it lands on a sword, you strike. If it lands on a shield, you defend.

Half skill, half faith—the outcome of every battle depends on both your planning and the whims of fortune.
